Japan's Ministry of Economy, Trade and Industry (METI) said they have learned that 27 products were damaged by fire in the facility.

Hmm, let me reconsider: the text appears to be a mix resembling Hausa/Fulfulde. The most plausible reading is:

Japan's Ministry of Economy, Trade and Industry (METI) said it is aware that there was damage, with 27 items affected by the heaters.

Japan's Ministry of Economy, Trade and Industry (METI) said it has learned that there were 27 incidents of damage caused by the heaters.
